Interim snapshot from the standalone `fix/routing-on-main` branch: llm-mailroom
`main` with the merged decision reviewer (#134), plus the review-evidence and
routing fixes, including review of unsure decision classes and reviewer correction of a low sorter, not a merged release. On that branch the upstream suite matches
`main` with 18 more passing tests; its 54 failures and 7 errors also occur on
`main` in the same environment. Upstream merge and subsequent release refresh
remain gated on operator approval. No vendor implementation was edited by hand.

Changes originate in the authoritative standalone repository, are committed and
reviewed there, then consumed here. Never patch this snapshot or export hub
changes back into the owning repository. After importing the same revisions,
the Digital-Mailroom workspace and these generated snapshots must match.

Dojo owns scoring; llm-mailroom owns the pipeline. Production corporate v6
and sandbox evaluation v7 remain separate intentional prompt catalogs.

(`langchain_agents/prompts.py`, `langchain_agents/doc_inventories.py`).
